Keep Your Routine Simple

After cleansing, apply a small amount of cream to clean, dry skin as directed on the product packaging. Start gradually when introducing any new active skincare product, and avoid applying to irritated or broken skin.

Use sunscreen during the day, especially when your routine includes ingredients such as Kojic Acid. Patch test first and adjust use if your skin feels uncomfortable.
